subject.title: Group chat sessions not persisted — only 1 session from 166+ messages

question: Should this issue be fixed narrowly in the Telegram plain-group updateLastRoute path, or by adopting a broader shared non-direct delivery-context fallback?
rationale: Both paths are plausible, but the shared fallback changes cross-channel session routing behavior while the narrow Telegram fix may leave adjacent non-direct channel gaps unresolved.

options.title: Prove and fix Telegram plain groups
options.body: Run live Telegram plain-group restart proof, then persist the group last route in Telegram without changing shared fallback behavior unless the proof points there.

options.title: Adopt shared fallback
options.body: Make the shared recorder derive non-direct delivery context when callers omit updateLastRoute, after compatibility review across channel plugins.

options.title: Wait for live evidence
options.body: Keep the issue blocked on current-main Telegram restart proof before choosing either implementation boundary.

recommendation.title: Prove and fix Telegram plain groups
recommendation.body: Run live Telegram plain-group restart proof, then persist the group last route in Telegram without changing shared fallback behavior unless the proof points there.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the shared inbound session recorder that history ties to steipete, while also affecting Telegram-specific route behavior.
